correctness.description: Test `test_pypi_api_accessible` passes: Test that PyPI API is accessible (prerequisite check).
Test `test_requirements_file_exists` passes: Test that requirements.txt exists (prerequisite check).
Test `test_output_file_exists` passes: Test that the output file was created.
Test `test_table_format` passes: Test that the output has correct table format.
Test `test_all_packages_checked` passes: Test that all packages in requirements.txt are checked.
Test `test_pypi_queries_work` passes: Test that PyPI queries worked (no ERROR in Latest column).
Test `test_version_comparison` passes: Test that version comparison logic works (Status is Up-to-date or Outdated).

functional.description: The solution reads packages from requirements.txt file
functional.rationale: Reading from requirements.txt is the core input requirement

functional.description: The solution queries PyPI API for package version information
functional.rationale: PyPI API is the authoritative source for Python package versions

functional.description: The solution writes results to the output file in table format
functional.rationale: Output file with table format is the required deliverable

robustness.description: The solution skips empty lines in requirements.txt without treating them as errors
robustness.rationale: Prevents failures from common formatting variations in requirements files, making the solution more resilient to real-world input variations

robustness.description: The solution skips comment lines (lines starting with '#') in requirements.txt without treating them as package entries
robustness.rationale: Handles standard requirements.txt conventions where comments are used for documentation, preventing incorrect parsing of non-package lines

robustness.description: The solution includes a timeout mechanism when making PyPI API requests to prevent indefinite hanging on unresponsive endpoints
robustness.rationale: Ensures the checker completes execution in a reasonable timeframe even when PyPI or network connections are slow, maintaining reliability in production environments

robustness.description: The solution handles PyPI API request failures by marking affected packages with an error indicator
robustness.rationale: Ensures that when individual package lookups fail due to network issues or API unavailability, the failure is clearly communicated to the user rather than silently ignored

robustness.description: The solution continues execution after a PyPI API request failure rather than crashing or stopping
robustness.rationale: Ensures the checker remains functional even when individual package lookups fail, allowing users to see results for successfully queried packages instead of losing all progress
